mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_plan (id, user_id, plan_days, goal, activity_level, target_weight, start_weight, prefs, avoid, focus_parts, status, cur_day, created_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{planDays}, #{goal}, #{activityLevel}, #{targetWeight}, #{startWeight}, #{prefs}, #{avoid}, #{focusParts}, #{status}, #{curDay}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_plan WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM user_plan WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_plan SET status = 40, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN (10, 20) AND deleted = 0
